notes.title: 2019/01/31 Hot fix:
notes.content:
1. Updated functional items: Chest, which can store 12 items
2. Added synthetic formula (rich formula)
3. Can make more items (lights, colors, gold brick walls)
4. New branch synthetic technology tree (gold coin casting technology)
5. New branch synthetic technology tree (dye process)
6. Players at levels 6 to 19 need 60% less experience
7. Full level 20-> level 25
8. New monster: armored dragon
9. New Boss monster: black armored dragon, refrigeration guard
10. Initial items: rich -> average (survival difficulty, slightly increased)
11. Monster drops: a small amount -> rich
12. Part of the new UI

notes.title: 1.0.2.0 version update:
notes.content:
It is suggested that create new maps or go far to explore, and there will be some surprises.

1. the new naturally generated buildings have been added.
2. you can find new buildings in the ice area, grassland, desert, red soil and other ecological areas.
3. joining these buildings will enrich the world.
4. repair some BUG;
5. adds some basic code for subsequent functions, though these codes do not affect the current game.
6. the problems caused by some shadow are optimized.
7. other performance optimization;
